outcome: etiologies of fever (e.g., viral infections, influenza, pyelonephritis, chorioamnionitis)
cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women who consulted for fever above 38 degC in a gynecological emergency ward between August 2016 and July 2017.
finding: The main etiologies of fever during pregnancy were common viral infections (37%), influenza (21%), and pyelonephritis (11%), with 13% of all patients experiencing complications.
